note: Compiled on 19 October 2026 from the public repository's history; it was not published alongside each release. Each entry links to its commit on main or to the pull request that published it, where the merge commit is shown. Counts are those of data/evidence.json and data/ontology.json in that version; for registry versions the date is the registry's as-of date. Corrections changed content that had already been published; pre-release review fixes were made before a version was merged and were never published.

entries.title: Registry v0.4.1: published data documented and independently verifiable
changes: A data reference page (/data/) describing the published files, identifiers, provenance, null and absent values, versions, coverage limits and which parts of Q8 and Q9 can be recomputed from the data.
A manifest (/data/manifest.json) listing each published JSON file with its SHA-256, so that a consumer can tell whether the files it fetched belong to the same build.
matrix.json and the published gaps.json now carry the rules used to derive them; data/gaps.json defines its states.

An example consumer (/examples/registry_consumer.py, Python standard library only) that checks the published data and recomputes the matrix, the gap checks and digests, and the reproducible parts of Q8 and Q9.

Evidence cards no longer extend past narrow screens when a quotation contains a long unbroken string, including while web fonts load or when they are blocked; the homepage navigation fits a 320-pixel screen.
No record, entity or relationship was added or changed.
corrections: ontology.json carried version 0.3.0 and as-of date 18 October 2026 in v0.4.0, although its content had changed in that version; it now carries the registry version and date, and the validator requires both files to agree.
The registry index said the registry did not yet cover AI companies, models or datasets, which it has covered since v0.2.0.

entries.title: Registry v0.4.0: institutional matrix and evidence gaps
changes: Institutional evidence matrix: each organisation's and initiative's documented relationships, with classification, the related entity's status, sources and qualifications, also as matrix.json.
Evidence gap register: five open questions, with what the registry establishes, what it does not and what would resolve each, also as gaps.json; gaps are re-checked against the data on every build.
Questions Q8 (organisations and projects) and Q9 (official targets and recorded progress).

Two records: the ministry's presentation of the Maroc IA 2030 roadmap's main advances (MAI-EV-0040), and a peer-reviewed article on Toubkal reporting large-language-model fine-tuning, written by authors affiliated with its host university (MAI-EV-0041).

entries.title: Registry v0.3.0: AI deployment evidence
changes: Rules for operational and pilot claims: the basis must be stated, the operator named separately from any provider or developer, and outcomes are never recorded as facts.
First AI application recorded as operational (Idarati AI), on the basis of public availability only; use is not documented.
Health and financial-services entries, recorded as announced.
Questions page: deployments, operators, evidence recency, unresolved entries.
A separate source checker that re-fetches sources without changing data.
corrections: DeepEcho software changed from in development (published in v0.2.0) to unresolved: the FDA record contradicts the company website's disclaimer, which no longer sets a stage and is marked superseded.
review_fixes: FDA wording limited to 510(k) clearance, and the applicant's link to the Moroccan company recorded as an association, not a legal identity.
A provider attribution for Idarati AI (Berexia) removed: the label appears only in interface text and is not shown on the assistant.

entries.title: Registry v0.2.0: companies, models, datasets and lifecycle stages
changes: AI companies, open models and datasets, and compute infrastructure.
Lifecycle stages for projects, models and datasets, each backed by a record that declares the stage.
First version of the questions page.
corrections: The higher-education ministry, recorded in v0.1.0 as involved in the Nador memorandum, recorded as a signatory on a new source naming the signatories.
review_fixes: The DarijaBERT developer link classified as independent analysis: the model card names "AIOX Lab", and identification is by name.
UM6P Ventures' origin set to unresolved; Toubkal recorded as compute infrastructure, not as an AI application.

entries.title: Registry v0.1.0: evidence registry, ontology and quality gates
changes: Evidence registry and ontology with claim classifications, a validator and automated quality gates.
Generated registry pages, an independence statement on every page and self-hosted fonts.
corrections: Unsourced claims, rules that were not true of the site and placeholder links on the original homepage removed or corrected.
review_fixes: The CNDP recorded as listing Law 09-08 in its regulatory framework, not as administering it.
Conventions signed for the creation of Jazari institutes not presented as constituted institutions.

entries.title: Site created
changes: Initial single-page site committed; the CNAME for themoroccoai.com was added the same day (commit 9ac75fd).
